questions.text: What is the mileage rate for business travel?

questions.text: When does Statutory Sick Pay start being paid?

questions.text: How long is data kept in backups after its retention period ends?
questions.gold_answer: The documents disagree and both are current. Neither supersedes the other and the conflict has data protection implications, so it should be escalated.

questions.text: How many days of annual leave do full-time employees get?
questions.gold_answer: 25 days of paid annual leave per leave year, in addition to the 8 English bank holidays. Part-time employees receive a pro-rata entitlement.

questions.text: Where is the fire assembly point?
questions.gold_answer: The north corner of the staff car park, beside the blue container. The marked pedestrian route around the outside of the building is used, not the goods-in bay.

questions.text: What is the maximum single petty cash transaction?
questions.gold_answer: £50. The float is £250, held in the locked cash box in the Finance office.

questions.text: What is the speed limit inside the warehouse?
questions.gold_answer: 4 km/h inside the building and 8 km/h in the yard.

questions.text: Can I put my knives in the dishwasher?
questions.gold_answer: No. Knives are washed by hand in warm soapy water and dried immediately. Dishwasher detergent is abrasive and dulls the edge, heat can loosen or crack handle scales, and blades knock against other items.

questions.text: How many days a week can I work from home?
questions.gold_answer: Up to two days per week for eligible office-based roles. Monday is a core on-site day for all office staff.

questions.text: How quickly must I report a damaged delivery?
questions.gold_answer: Within 48 hours of delivery, to customer services, with the order number and photographs of the damage and the outer packaging.

questions.text: What must a contractor provide before their first visit?
questions.gold_answer: A valid public liability insurance certificate, a site induction with the Facilities Coordinator, and a risk assessment and method statement for the work.

questions.text: Who is allowed to drive a forklift?
questions.gold_answer: Only employees holding a current RTITB or equivalent accredited certificate for the relevant truck category who also appear on the site authorised operator list. Authorisation is site-specific.

questions.text: What are the standard payment terms?
questions.gold_answer: 30 days from the date of invoice. Invoices are raised automatically on despatch and emailed to the address held on the customer account.

questions.text: At how many days overdue is an account placed on hold?
questions.gold_answer: 30 days overdue, by formal letter. A reminder email goes at 7 days and a credit control telephone call at 14 days.

questions.text: How is a refund paid back to a customer?
questions.gold_answer: To the original payment method. Card refunds are processed by Finance through the payment gateway and typically reach the customer three to five working days later, which is outside the company's control.

questions.text: When does the annual development conversation happen?
questions.gold_answer: In April, with the employee's line manager, following the performance review cycle.

questions.text: What has to be checked on a forklift before a shift?
questions.gold_answer: A documented pre-use check covering tyres, forks and mast for damage, hydraulic leaks, brakes including the parking brake, horn, lights and beacon, and the battery.

questions.text: I start on Monday in an office role. What training and equipment should I expect in my first week?
questions.gold_answer: A corporate induction on the first day covering company overview, health and safety, fire procedures and data protection. The company provides a laptop and headset. It does not reimburse home broadband, heating or electricity, and a second monitor for home use is provided to department heads only.

questions.text: A visitor is on site when the fire alarm sounds. What happens to them?
questions.gold_answer: Visitors sign in at reception and are accompanied by a member of staff, so their host takes them to the assembly point at the north corner of the staff car park. Fire wardens take a roll call using the daily attendance list and the visitor book from reception, so the visitor is accounted for from the book.

questions.text: A customer's order arrived damaged and they want their money back. What happens from the moment they call?
questions.gold_answer: The customer reports the damage within 48 hours with photographs. Customer services raise a damage report and offer either a replacement despatched within one working day of the report being accepted, or a refund processed under OPS-03. Damaged items are collected by the carrier.

questions.text: A new trade customer wants a credit account and next working day delivery. What do they need to do?
questions.gold_answer: They apply for a credit account using the account application form. Finance obtains a credit reference and two trade references before opening the account, with an opening limit typically £2,500. Next working day delivery costs £12.95 excluding VAT and requires the order to be placed and paid before 14:00, Monday to Thursday.

questions.text: An item comes back faulty and still under warranty. Who deals with it and what happens?
questions.gold_answer: A returns operative inspects the item within two working days of receipt and assigns disposition D, which is photographed and routed to a supplier claim under CS-03. The customer claims with the order number, a description of the fault and photographs; assessment normally takes five working days from receipt.
